craft_evidence.owned: no: "partnering with workshops, mills and factories operated by people we have the utmost admiration for" (/pages/about)
craft_evidence.makers: no: makers are placed by region only — Tuscany (RTW & MTM tailoring), Liguria (bespoke), Naples (trousers), Lombardy (shirting), Veneto (buttons), Como (linings) (/pages/services-25)
craft_evidence.mills: no names: own "Tessuti" cloth woven with "small mills in Prato, Biella and Huddersfield" (/pages/tessuti); product pages give composition and weight, no mill
craft_evidence.madein: 92/92 styles state a country on the product page or feed
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed, young: "Founded by Jake Grantham in 2017 ... based in Marylebone, London" (/pages/about)
craft_evidence.process: partial: own cloth designed since 2019 with a heavily milled matte "Anglo finish"; a category-by-region map of where each part is made; house tailoring style described (/pages/tessuti, /pages/services-25)
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every style states a country (almost all Italy) and the house publishes a region-by-region map of its making and designs its own cloth. But it names no workshop or mill, and owns nothing; the rubric step for naming makers or mills (3) is not reached.
